description: Implementation of ProductRelationshipService interface managing CRUD operations for product relationships, including group management, activation/deactivation, and retrieval by various criteria.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation managing product relationships, including group operations, activation, deactivation, and retrieval functions.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product relationship or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates and adds a new product relationship group to the specified store.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all groups associated with the specified store.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes all product relationships belonging to a specific group in the store.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates a specified group in the store.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates a specified group in the store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product relationship after re-fetching it by ID.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Lists all relationships associated with a given product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store, product, type, and language.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store, type, and language.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store and type.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store and group name.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships filtered by store, group name, and language.
